item.title: [DEVELOPING] Yoba malware spread via fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps on GitHub
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from Check Point Research. Source: https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/tricks-from-the-past-deployed-via-signed-chatgpt-and-claude-binaries

item.title: [DEVELOPING] BUGSTER uses DeepSeek V4 as AI cybercrime assistant against Indian universities
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from GBHackers. Per Unit 42, threat actor BUGSTER configured DeepSeek V4 as the reasoning engine for AI-assisted reconnaissance and scripting against organizations in India, including universities, to steal data. Source: https://gbhackers.com/deepseek-ai-exploited

item.title: [DEVELOPING] St Petersburg choreographer scammed by AI avatar of Governor Beglov
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from Рамблер. Scammers reportedly used an AI avatar of St Petersburg governor Alexander Beglov to deceive choreographer Komleva. Loss amount and method are not stated. Source: https://news.google.?oc=5

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Unvetted AI agents detected operating inside US customer bank accounts
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from Reddit r/netsec.
